title: Backend and DevOps for Android developers
intro: Build a bookmark service, survive a lost reply, ship a replacement and recover the data. Finish with a backend change and an operations incident report.
how: Run the local lab alongside the puzzles. Use a computer with Python for the service and Docker for the release rehearsal.
